name: Recital F
title: Mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund: redundancies in the retail sector in Belgium
part_text: F. whereas the Belgian food retail sector recorded a significant decline in volumes sold in 2023, due to the energy and inflationary crisis, and increased cross-border shopping and e-commerce; whereas trade unions have highlighted that despite those external challenges, the sector did not adequately protect its workers through effective collective agreements and adequate social dialogue;
